gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-nandinagari: Futuristic and tile-like, Audiowide stamps its wide-spaced glyphs across the top. Noto Sans Nandinagari follows with generous openings and short ascenders, and that gentle, approachable quality is what the pair does best.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-archivo: Balsamiq Sans keeps one stencil-cut weight from end to end. Archivo drops in beneath with a taller lowercase and outward-opening curves, so the loud heading and the sturdy text settle into each other.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-montserrat: A stencil-cut channel of constant weight, with no pinched curves, defines Balsamiq Sans. And Montserrat glides beneath it, its oversized counters and generous white space making the clearest strength of the pairing.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-satoshi: Balsamiq Sans brings a stencil-cut, constant-weight line with no pinched curves, loud and expressive. But Satoshi does the quieter work, with a wide e that never looks squeezed shut and a soaring x-height.
gen-gf-baumans-fs-supreme: A c like a crescent wrench opened wide gives Baumans its look. Supreme backs it with a crisp, heavy-looking band of text and letters held open, which is the pairing's best trait.
gen-gf-baumans-switzer: Crescent-wrench curves and one steady thickness give Baumans its punch. That commanding display job belongs to the heading, while Switzer carries the text with tubular, wire-like letterforms and a tall waist line.
gen-gf-bellota-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Distinctive from the first glance, Bellota hangs its s ends far from the spine. While Be Vietnam Pro keeps its curve endings well apart, its steel-rod strokes carry the text.
gen-gf-bellota-fs-merriweather-sans: Merriweather Sans makes words look sturdy and large through its tall lowercase. Merriweather Sans keeps its e open to the right, so paragraphs move smoothly beneath the blunt, marker-tipped Bellota heading.
gen-gf-bellota-fs-ranade: Hairline-free strokes and a blunt, commanding look: that is Bellota. Ranade adds an organic looseness, its weight shifting slightly and its stroke ends set wide, which is the pairing's best trait.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-syncopate: Syncopate sets open, technical-pen shapes at rope-ladder intervals, steady and crisp. And Bellota, with its far-hanging s and stylus-width strokes, brings the distinctive, commanding quality that stands out most.
